newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Wallis says to highlight Australia tax issues.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Wallis says to highlight Australia tax issues.

text.p: Stan Wallis, the chairman of the government's inquiry into the financial system, said on Wednesday the inquiry would highlight tax issues in its report to the government, but would not be making any recommendations.
Wallis told an Australian Securities Commission (ASC) conference that his inquiry was not allowed to make recommendations about tax.
"All we will be doing is highlighting some tax issues, but there will be no recommendations," Wallis said.
Some banks had called on the Wallis inquiry to investigate the various taxes, state and federal, levied on financial transactions and other capital flows.

Earlier in his speech to the ASC conference, Wallis said the emergence of the Internet and globally available financial products would have tax implications for various governments and raised questions about where an Internet product should be taxed.
